The '''Journal of Darth Malgus''' was a war journal kept by [[Darth Malgus]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and was acquired by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] decades before the rise of his [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] through an antiquities dealer. Sidious passed it to his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], in the hopes it would inspire him. Vader found many similarities between himself and Malgus, and annotated the remains of the journal heavily, expressing regret that no more of it survived.
